contradictions.order_of_work: The thresholds, the masking of numbers for the reranker and the name rule were chosen on the development half. The held-out half was then run once without the answer model (3 false pairs of 23, all of the class property). The confirmation by the answer model was added after that result was seen; its prompt uses development examples only, and the held-out half was run with it afterwards (0 false pairs of 23, twice).
